title: Unit 13 Information and Communication Technology (part 3)
source: science (1) — Unit 13 Information and Communication Technology, pages 90-93 [science (1).pdf]
textbookText: 1. A good netizen communicates politely and shows respect to others while interacting online. 2. They follow digital laws and ethical rules, avoiding piracy, hacking, and misuse of information. 3. A good netizen protects personal and others’ privacy by using strong passwords and not sharing sensitive data. 4. They use the internet responsibly by sharing accurate information and avoiding cyberbullying or harmful content. 3. When using online technology, it is necessary to take care of digital well-being. Why? Clarify with two examples. Ans:- It is necessary to take care of digital well-being while using online technology because excessive or unsafe use can harm mental health, privacy, and overall life balance. Maintaining digital well-being helps users stay safe, healthy, and productive in the digital world. Examples: 1. Excessive use of social media can cause stress, anxiety, and addiction, so limiting screen time helps maintain mental

well-being. 2. Careless sharing of personal information online can lead to cybercrime or identity theft, so protecting privacy ensures digital safety. 4. Write four advantages of digital transmission. Ans:- Four advantages of digital transmission are:

1. Digital transmission is less affected by noise and interference, so signals are more reliable over long distances. 2. Errors in digital signals can be detected and corrected easily, improving accuracy of communication. 3. Digital data can be stored, processed, and compressed efficiently using computers and digital devices. 4. It provides better security through encryption, making data transmission safer and more private. 5. Explain the impact of digital technology on the development of information and communication technology with any two examples. Ans:- Digital technology has greatly accelerated the development of information and communication technology by making information faster to process, easier to store, and quicker to share across the world. It has improved connectivity, efficiency, and accessibility of communication systems. Examples: 1. The use of the internet and email enables instant sharing of information globally, replacing slow traditional

communication methods like postal mail. 2. Digital mobile phones and video conferencing allow real-time voice and visual communication, supporting online education, business meetings, and remote work.
6. Present any four examples of digital technology used in daily life. Ans:- Four examples of digital technology used in daily life are:

1. Smartphones – used for communication, internet access, online learning, and digital payments. 2. Computers/Laptops – used for education, office work, data processing, and entertainment. 3. Digital Banking and Mobile Payment Systems – used for online money transfer, bill payment, and shopping. 4. Smart Television and Streaming Services – used for watching digital content, news, and online programs. 7. Write two positive and negative effects of digital technology in daily life. Ans:- Positive effects of digital technology: 1. It makes communication fast and easy through mobile phones, email, and social media. 2. It improves access to information, online education, digital banking, and other essential services. Negative effects of digital technology: 1. Excessive use can cause health problems such as eye strain, stress, and digital addiction. 2. Misuse of digital technology can lead to cybercrime, privacy loss, and the spread of false information. 8. White any four precautions that are necessary for digital well being. Ans:- Four precautions necessary for digital well-being are: 1. Limit screen time and take regular breaks to protect eye health and mental well-being. 2. Use strong passwords and two-factor authentication to keep accounts secure. 3. Avoid sharing personal or sensitive information on social media and unknown websites. 4. Think critically before posting or sharing content to prevent misinformation and cyberbullying. 9. Mention four importance of digital reputation management. Ans:- Four importance of digital reputation management are: 1. It helps build trust and credibility among employers, customers, and the public. 2. It protects personal and professional image from negative or false online content. 3. Good digital reputation improves career and business opportunities. 4. It encourages responsible and ethical behavior in online activities.
